tools.name: -health-check
tools.description: Internal health check tool. Verifies connectivity to backend.

tools.name: list-agents
tools.description: List agents owned by the user or in their workspaces.

workspaceId.description: Optional: Filter agents by workspace ID. If not provided, lists all accessible agents.

tools.name: get-agent
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific agent.

tools.name: create-agent
tools.description: Create a new agent instance. The core is assigned automatically by scope (no workspace → super-agent; workspace → agent).

fullName.description: Full name for the agent (e.g., 'Alice Evergreen')

workspaceId.description: Optional: Workspace ID to create the agent in. If not provided, creates a global agent. Pass null explicitly to create a Superagent (a global agent with elevated capabilities not bound to any workspace).

tools.name: update-agent
tools.description: Update an existing agent's properties.

avatarUrl.description: URL of the agent avatar image

context.description: Agent-specific context that gets injected into the system prompt. Use this to provide agent-specific instructions, guidelines, or knowledge. Supports markdown.

tools.name: delete-agent
tools.description: Delete an agent. This also removes all app access grants for the agent.

tools.name: list-agent-apps
tools.description: List all apps an agent has access to.

tools.name: get-agent-providers
tools.description: Get the LLM provider configuration for an agent. Returns the agent's available providers, preferred provider, and selected model.

tools.name: set-agent-providers
tools.description: Set the available LLM providers for an agent. This determines which providers the agent can use. Requires workspace access or agent ownership.

providerIds.description: Array of provider IDs to make available to this agent

tools.name: set-agent-preferred-provider
tools.description: Set the preferred LLM provider for an agent. The provider must be in the agent's available providers list. Pass null to clear the preference.

providerId.description: Provider ID to set as preferred (must be in availableProviders), or null to clear

tools.name: list-workspaces
tools.description: List workspaces the user owns or is a member of.

tools.name: get-workspace
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific workspace.

tools.name: create-workspace
tools.description: Create a new workspace with its own volume.

tools.name: update-workspace
tools.description: Update workspace properties including the context that gets injected into agent system prompts.

context.description: Context text that gets injected into agent system prompts. Use this to provide project-specific information, guidelines, coding standards, or any other context that agents should know. Supports markdown and can be long (multiple paragraphs).

tools.name: archive-workspace
tools.description: Archive a workspace (soft delete). Only the owner can archive.

tools.name: add-workspace-member
tools.description: Add a member to a workspace.

tools.name: remove-workspace-member
tools.description: Remove a member from a workspace.

tools.name: update-workspace-member-role
tools.description: Update a member's role in a workspace.

tools.name: list-apps
tools.description: List apps owned by the user.

workspaceId.description: Optional: Filter apps by workspace ID. If not provided, lists all apps owned by the user across all workspaces.

tools.name: get-app
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific app.

tools.name: install-app
tools.description: Install an MCA from the catalog as an app. The installed app is auto-granted to the user's superagents. Apps are scoped to a workspace: their tools are only available in conversations of that workspace.

name.description: Optional: Custom name for the app (lower-kebab-case). Auto-generated if not provided.

workspaceId.description: Optional: Workspace ID to install the app in. Defaults to the user's Private Workspace. To use the app's tools in the current conversation, install it in the conversation's workspace.

tools.name: uninstall-app
tools.description: Uninstall an app. This also removes all agent access grants.

tools.name: rename-app
tools.description: Rename an installed app.

tools.name: check-app-auth
tools.description: Check an app's authentication status (connected, expired, missing credentials, not required) without showing anything to the user. Use it to verify auth before or after operating an app. If the status is broken, use show-app-auth so the user can fix it from the chat — never ask for credentials directly.

appId.description: The app whose authentication status to check

tools.name: show-app-auth
tools.description: Show an app's authentication widget to the user, inline in the chat, so they can connect or re-authenticate it right there (e.g. reconnect Gmail when the OAuth session expired). Use it when an app's tools fail for auth reasons (expired session, missing credentials). Returns the app's current auth status so you can tell the user what needs fixing. Never ask the user for credentials directly — the widget is the only place they should enter them.

appId.description: The app whose authentication section to show

tools.name: list-app-access
tools.description: List all agents that have access to an app.

tools.name: workspace-app-list
tools.description: List apps in a workspace.

workspaceId.description: The workspace ID to list apps for

tools.name: workspace-agent-list
tools.description: List agents in a workspace.

workspaceId.description: The workspace ID to list agents for

tools.name: list-catalog
tools.description: List all MCAs available in the catalog.

tools.name: list-providers
tools.description: List all LLM providers available to the user. Returns providers with their models, status, and configuration.

tools.name: grant-app-access
tools.description: Grant an agent access to an app.

agentId.description: The agent to grant access to

appId.description: The app to grant access to

tools.name: revoke-app-access
tools.description: Revoke an agent's access to an app.

agentId.description: The agent to revoke access from

appId.description: The app to revoke access to

tools.name: get-app-permissions
tools.description: Get the tool permissions of an app: each tool's configured permission ('allow' runs without asking, 'ask' requires user confirmation, 'forbid' is blocked), its manifest flags (readOnly, alwaysAsk), and a summary.

appId.description: The app whose permissions to read

tools.name: set-app-permissions
tools.description: Set tool permissions for an app, in batch. Values: 'allow' (runs without asking), 'ask' (requires user confirmation), 'forbid' (blocked), 'default' (clear the explicit setting so the tool falls back to the app default). Use `tools` for per-tool changes and/or `all` to change every tool at once; `all: 'default'` resets the whole app to defaults.

appId.description: The app whose permissions to change

all.description: Set every tool of the app at once; 'default' resets all tools to the app default

tools.description: Per-tool changes: a map of tool name to 'allow' | 'ask' | 'forbid' | 'default'. Applied on top of `all` when both are given.

tools.name: skill-list
tools.description: List all skills in a workspace.

workspaceId.description: The workspace ID to list skills from

tools.name: skill-create
tools.description: Create a new skill in a workspace.

workspaceId.description: The workspace ID to create the skill in

content.description: Markdown content / instructions for the skill

tools.name: skill-update
tools.description: Update an existing skill.

content.description: New Markdown content / instructions for the skill

tools.name: skill-delete
tools.description: Delete a skill and all its agent access entries.

tools.name: skill-grant-access
tools.description: Assign a skill to an agent.

agentId.description: The agent ID to assign the skill to

tools.name: skill-revoke-access
tools.description: Remove a skill assignment from an agent.

agentId.description: The agent ID to remove the skill from

tools.name: skill-set-enabled
tools.description: Enable or disable a skill for a specific agent.

enabled.description: Whether to enable (true) or disable (false) the skill for the agent

tools.name: skill-get-agent-skills
tools.description: Get all skills assigned to an agent.

agentId.description: The agent ID to get skills for
